Hello,

I am trying to use R to visualize a dataset and need to reshape it first. The data is collected over two months (in day interval); each date a continuous (weight) and a categorical (stage) variable is recorded for each of the 125 individuals (from different groups). And the dataset contains many missing values as the day progresses. I am trying to reshape data set in such a way that it can be used to visualize different stages of the remaining individuals (color coded by groups) across all the dates.

I have created a miniature version of the data set and looking forward to any support. I am wondering if I can do it without splitting the data set for weight and stage in two excel sheets.

Any help will be highly appreciated.

jamuna
